items.name: House Ale
items.description: The Dragon's Hollow house brew. Reliable, smooth, no surprises.
items.flavor_text: Tam slides a frothy mug across the bar. It's good. It's always good.

items.name: Dwarven Stout
items.description: Dark, heavy, and it fights back. Not for lightweights.
items.flavor_text: The stout is nearly black. Tam watches to see if you flinch on the first sip.

items.name: Harvest Wheat
items.description: Light and golden. Tastes like a sunny afternoon in a field.
items.flavor_text: Easy drinking. Tam approves - sometimes you don't need to prove anything.

items.name: Firewhiskey
items.description: Burns going down. Burns coming back up if you're not careful.
items.flavor_text: Tam pours a measure and slides it over with a knowing look. 'Sip it, lamb. Don't be a hero.'

items.name: Orcish Grog
items.description: Tam's personal recipe. She won't tell you what's in it. You don't want to know.
items.flavor_text: It's green. It's thick. It smells like courage and bad decisions. Tam grins as she pours it.

items.name: Backroom Moonshine
items.description: Not technically on the menu. You have to know to ask. Now you know.
items.flavor_text: Tam reaches under the bar and produces an unlabeled bottle. 'Tam didn't sell you this. Understand?'

items.name: Okhan Red
items.description: Local vineyard. Dry, earthy, a little bitter. Like the city itself.
items.flavor_text: A proper glass of wine. Tam pours it with more care than the ales get.

items.name: Elven White
items.description: Imported. Delicate, floral, probably too fancy for this bar. Tam stocks it anyway.
items.flavor_text: Tam handles the bottle gently. 'Expensive stuff, sweetling. Savor it.'

items.name: Tam's Stew
items.description: Different every day. Always good. Don't ask what's in it.
items.flavor_text: A steaming bowl appears in front of you. You didn't order it. Tam doesn't care. 'Eat.'

items.name: Bread & Cheese
items.description: Fresh bread, sharp cheese. Simple. Perfect.
items.flavor_text: A thick slice of bread and a wedge of cheese. Tam nods approvingly when you eat.

items.name: Meat Pie
items.description: Flaky crust, hearty filling. Tam's second specialty after the stew.
items.flavor_text: Golden-crusted and still hot from the kitchen. 'Made fresh this morning, lamb.'

items.name: The Hero's Toast
items.description: A legendary drink for legendary people. Tam only makes it for those who've earned it.
items.flavor_text: Tam takes her time with this one. Multiple bottles, precise pours, a sprinkle of something she won't name. She sets it down with ceremony. 'You earned this, sweetling.'

items.name: Forget-Me-Not
items.description: You won't remember the night but you'll feel the hangover for days. Worth it.
items.flavor_text: Tam raises an eyebrow. 'You sure about this one, lamb?' She pours it anyway. It shimmers.
